subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce our upcoming Annual Charity Gala event scheduled for next month. This event is a great opportunity for us to come together, celebrate our achievements, and contribute to a good cause. We will have live music, a silent auction, and a delicious dinner. Please mark your calendars and RSVP by the end of the week if you plan to attend. Looking forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
